title: Undead Mahjong
description: Undead Mahjong is a thrilling Halloween-themed puzzle game where players match spooky tiles featuring ghosts, skeletons, and eerie symbols. Challenge yourself to clear the board by connecting identical tiles and unlock haunted levels filled with Halloween vibes. Perfect for fans of Mahjong and Halloween, this puzzle offers fun and frights in every level!
instructions: Use your mouse or touchpad to click and match two identical tiles Clear the board by connecting matching tiles with a path that has no more than two turns
